To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
DRB1*1501 and DR5 serologic group are both associated with adult onset Still’s disease (AOS) susceptibility, and DRB1*0901 is associated with AOS susceptibility in Japanese subjects.
the DRB1 alleles were associated with AOSDs susceptibility and DRB1 alleles may influence the clinical features of AOSD.
HLA-DR alleles are associated with AOSDs susceptibility, and that DR5 is associated with MAS and steroid pulse therapy.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the association of DRB alleles with AOSD in the Japanese population.
the effects of HLA- DRB1 alleles on clinical characteristics of AOSD.
the effects of DR5 on the susceptibility to MAS and steroid pulse therapy in Japanese patients with AODS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
DR5 is associated with AOSDs, especially in patients with MEFV mutations.
the DR5 allele in patients with AODS with MEFV variants are associated with MAS and the need for steroid pulse therapy.
the predisposing effect of the DR5 serological groups was confirmed only in Japanese patients with AODS who had MEF variants, and not in those who do not have MEF variants.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DRB1 alleles, especially the DR5 serological groups and amino acid residues of the DRβ chains at positions 86 and 96, are associated with susceptibility and clinical manifestations of Japanese patients with AODS.
the DRB1 alleles, especially DR5, may play an important role in the pathogenesis of AOSD in Japanese subjects.
HLA-DR5, especially DRB1*1501 is associated with susceptibility and DRB1*0901 with protection against AOSD in Japanese patients.
The main takeaway from our work is that
DR5 may be involved in the development of AOSD and the clinical manifestations, especially MAS.
the DR5 allele is associated with susceptibility to AOSDs in patients with MEFV variants.
the DRB1 alleles, DRB1* 09:01 and DRB1*01:01 are associated with a lower risk of AOSD, whereas DRB1*03:01 and DR*15:01 are associated to a higher risk of AOSDs.
